Done. I've implemented all three functions:

- **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in src/num.js: Uses Math.min/max to constrain n to [min, max]
- **`formatBytes(n)`** in src/util.js: Formats bytes with one decimal place, selecting B/KB/MB/GB by threshold
- **`slugify(title)`** in src/text.js: Lowercases, trims, replaces space runs with dashes, strips non-alphanumeric characters (except dashes)

Each is exported from its module, and I've noted the additions in CHANGELOG.md under [Unreleased].
